fix.shows: Pawan Khera of the Congress says the Commission's affidavit is riddled with inconsistencies and contradictions, and alleges that the government asked Meta to have copies of the affidavit and explanations of it taken down from Instagram. He names no post. Earlier the same day LiveLaw reported that Instagram had blocked for users in India its reel explaining the Commission's affidavit, with the message "We received a legal request to restrict this content". At 10:21 pm IST LiveLaw said Instagram had restored the video. Neither LiveLaw nor Instagram said who made the request. No statement from Meta, the government or the Commission on the request was found.
